name: See You at Work Tomorrow!
description: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

videos.title: Episode 1: Even if the Sky Falls, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Despite getting ghosted, Cha Ji-yoon still clocks in, only to get involved with 'Three-No-Man' Kang Si-woo. Learning his secret shakes up her life.

videos.title: Episode 2: Dreaming of Quitting, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Ji-yoon feels butterflies after sharing drinks with Si-woo. He comes to her with an unexpected proposal. Young-sam's power tripping drains Ji-yoon.

videos.title: Episode 3: Sick or Not, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Ji-yoon chooses to join the second-worst task force to dodge the worst, her boss. Ji-yoon and Si-woo are building a rapport when Ga-eul comes back.

videos.title: Episode 4: Broke Up Yesterday, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Things end for good with Ga-eul, but Ji-yoon still clocks in. Her dynamic with Si-woo shifts leading up to the 'sphere ice refrigerator' presentation.

videos.title: Episode 5: Have a "Meeting," Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Ji-yoon feels uneasy seeing Si-woo and Soo-jin close, but an accidental find at his place leaves her confused. Later, No-ah sets her up on a date.

videos.title: Episode 6: Busted for My Feelings, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: To suppress her feelings for Si-woo, Ji-yoon tries to leave the task force. But when he refuses to let her go, they develop feelings hard to ignore.

videos.title: Episode 7: Have a New Secret, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Ji-yoon and Si-woo start a secret romance. As the line between work and love blurs, Ga-eul reappears before a struggling Ji-yoon.

videos.title: Episode 8: Held Back by My Past, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: As the romance deepens, unvoiced thoughts and secrets grow. Meanwhile, Si-woo's failure to show up on Hye-ji's wedding leaves Ji-yoon anxious.

videos.title: Episode 9: There's an Error, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: When Ji-yoon asks for some time, Si-woo takes Seong-min's advice and lingers near. Meanwhile, Home-AI demo day arrives, and so does the Demo Ghost!

videos.title: Episode 10: Don't Know the Answer, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: While an unexpected event forces Ji-yoon to stay at Si-woo's, settling them into life's simple joys, her promotion sends Mr. Ko's envy spiraling.

videos.title: Episode 11: Even if Rumors Blur the Truth, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: Ji-yoon goes public to protect Si-woo, but intense public scrutiny backfires on them. Left with no choice, Si-woo makes a grave decision.

videos.title: Episode 12: No Map to Follow, Still Clocking In!
videos.overview: As Ji-yoon struggles with Si-woo's decision, Hye-gyeong discovers their romance. Will the two safely clock in for work tomorrow, and for love?
